mainText: Hello, Verona! At 10 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we have clear skies at 73 degrees near City Hall, and tonight's new moon phase adds a nice touch, with an overnight low of 69 degrees and no rain in the forecast.

The City of Verona has released notices for the August partisan primary and November elections, and residents should also prepare for upcoming construction on Highway M beginning August 18, which will shift traffic lanes for utility work.
We have plenty of fun ahead, including trivia at Hop Haus Brewing and Lake Lou-ee happening today, followed by the downtown Farmer's Market and more trivia at The Mill and The Bogey Factory tomorrow.
In a noteworthy call from last Wednesday, a 49-year-old man from Oregon was arrested for an O W I, fourth offence, after an officer observed erratic driving.

Today's flavor of the day is the delightful Chocolate Heath Crunch. Please note that the store is currently closed, but they will be ready to serve you starting at 10:00 AM tomorrow, when they will be featuring the Chocolate Covered Strawberry flavor.
